author: Coach DXC

title: It’s mileage rate
content:
Update 3.20.26, 
Received info back stating the new app update will address both issues asking to try that. Latest update shows 2.3 from 8 months ago. I may be too early as it doesn’t seem to be published yet. 
New problem is link to notify developer takes to a site and after putting in text and hit send, it doesn’t do anything or seem to go anywhere. Just says there is nothing here. That’s why using review to contact developer. 
I will update again and hope to give more stars once I have the new update mentioned in the communication. 
It’s a great app once these enhancements roll out. 

Need an update asap. This is a great application. It needs to be updated for the 2026 IRS mileage rate of 72.5 cents per mile. The program only seems to allow 2 decimal places and needs 3 for the new rate and won’t save if typed over. Be nice if you just update the size of the field and allow a save button to save it in settings so we can just set it ourselves. You don’t need to pull the rate from irs site. Be nice to be able to turn off the time tracking if not using that part and just use mileage.
author: Tlam5300

title: App doesn’t keep customized Settings
content: I used this app for several weeks now and I noticed the Settings always changes back to the default settings. It doesn’t keep your customized changes like hours work or automatically start when plugged in. I have to make the settings change every time I use the app.
author: Trieu_n_MN

title: I really wanted to like this
content: I just need a simple mileage tracker that isn’t going to steal all of my data and force me to subscribe every month. I thought this was the answer, but when I generated a test report, it came out formatted in a way that was a mess. I wish I could upload a screenshot to demonstrate what I ran into. I just want to be able to enter my odometer settings and then once a month generate a report that I can turn in to my office.
